messages.subject: Executive Value Creation Brief | TotalEnergies | Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Tuchscherer,

I am sharing a strategic value creation brief prepared for TotalEnergies, focused on public affairs, energy-security dialogue, stakeholder alignment and credible transition execution. My current work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and cross-functional execution in a multinational mining environment.

The attached brief outlines areas where this experience could support complex-market engagement and strategic delivery. I would welcome a short discussion regarding senior leadership or strategic mandates where my background would add value.

Regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for TotalEnergies
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Ragunauth Ramsaroop offers a leadership profile aligned with TotalEnergies' agenda across public affairs, energy security, sustainability, government relations and complex-market execution. His experience combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory in a multinational mining environment. He works across operations, legal, finance, procurement, HR, security, aviation and technical teams, translating external obligations into coordinated action. For TotalEnergies, the strongest contribution would sit where institutional engagement, transition strategy, stakeholder confidence and operational delivery must remain aligned across governments, regulators, communities, partners and senior management.
strategic_brief.company_context: TotalEnergies operates across oil and gas, LNG, electricity, renewables and lower-carbon energy in a geopolitical environment where energy security, affordability, transition policy and social expectations increasingly overlap. Its 2026 disclosures combine financial performance with an updated strategy outlook and formal Sustainability and Climate reporting. This creates a demanding public-affairs environment in which government positions, regulatory developments, project execution, stakeholder expectations and transition commitments must be coordinated consistently. Leaders who connect external affairs with internal operational ownership can strengthen policy engagement, improve institutional trust and help ensure strategic messages are supported by measurable delivery and credible evidence.

opportunities.title: Energy policy engagement
opportunities.rationale: Energy security and transition policy are increasingly shaped by geopolitical events, national priorities and regulatory change. Structured engagement helps maintain consistent positions while connecting policy dialogue to operating realities.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can build stakeholder maps, policy issue registers and executive engagement routines that connect government dialogue with legal, operational, sustainability and commercial ownership.

opportunities.title: Transition evidence governance
opportunities.rationale: Sustainability and climate commitments carry greater weight when reported progress, project evidence and operational ownership use consistent definitions and withstand scrutiny from governments, investors and communities.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can support evidence registers, accountability matrices and cross-functional assurance routines that translate transition commitments into defensible management information and stakeholder communication.

opportunities.title: Country stakeholder architecture
opportunities.rationale: Large energy projects depend on durable relationships with ministries, regulators, communities, contractors and strategic partners. Fragmented engagement can create inconsistent commitments and slower issue resolution.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can establish country-level stakeholder governance that aligns engagement priorities, commitments, owners, escalation paths and executive reporting across multiple institutional interfaces.

opportunities.title: Strategic issue management
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical, regulatory and community issues often cross organizational boundaries and require rapid coordination between public affairs, operations, security, legal and sustainability functions.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can support an executive issue-management process that converts external developments into decisions, accountable actions, stakeholder messages and documented follow-through.

days_0_30: Map priority policy, regulatory, community and partner interfaces.
days_31_60: Create policy issue registers, stakeholder calendars and executive escalation routines.
days_61_90: Launch cross-functional governance for priority public-affairs and transition workstreams.
days_91_180: Embed metrics, evidence assurance and executive reporting across selected markets.

potential_impact: Stronger consistency between public positions and operating delivery.
Improved institutional trust in complex markets.
More defensible sustainability and transition evidence.
Faster escalation of cross-functional external issues.
background_relevance: Government and regulatory relations across multiple public authorities.
ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and social-performance leadership.
Cross-functional coordination with operations, legal, finance, procurement and security.
Executive advisory experience in resource-sector environments with material stakeholder exposure.
